priorities.summary: Improper input validation in on-prem Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator lets an unauthenticated remote attacker reach privileged internal functionality and compromise the orchestrator host plus managed Edge devices in certificate-based deployments. Actively exploited; added to CISA KEV on Sep 22.

Unauthenticated privilege escalation in the WordPress plugin "Automation Web Platform – Notifications and OTP for WooCommerce" (≤4.8.6): its public REST signup route copies attacker-controlled fields into user meta with no allowlist, and the OTP step is bypassable — letting remote attackers register an admin account.

Remote code execution in Next.js 16.2.0–16.3.5 next/og ImageResponse on the Node.js runtime: unescaped values reach SVG output via the Satori library and crafted og-image requests can trigger server-side code execution. Fixed in Next.js 16.3.6.

model.name: GPT-6 Cyber — OpenAI
model.summary: OpenAI is reportedly preparing to unveil GPT-6 Cyber at DevDay on Sep 29: a cybersecurity-focused model for enterprise AI deployment and automated vulnerability patching, currently in alpha with Daybreak Red program customers. If confirmed it would be the company's fourth cyber-specialized model of 2026.
